title: Blanched Noodle Salad
description: A light and refreshing salad made with blanched noodles and Japanese-inspired ingredients.
instructions: Cook the noodles according to package instructions.
Blanch the noodles in boiling water for 2-3 minutes.
Drain and rinse the noodles with cold water.
In a large bowl, combine the blanched noodles, chopped cucumber, chopped carrot, and sliced green onion.
In a small bowl, whisk together the light sesame oil, soy sauce, and sesame seeds.
Pour the dressing over the noodle mixture and toss to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve chilled or at room temperature.
